notes.title: Tofradyr
notes.content:
Magic Axolotl may have a sequel.

The name is Tofradyr. It's going to be launched on Kickstarter at April 15, 2023.

Tofradyr is the continuation of the story with more characters, more enemies, bosses and more levels.

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatoalebrije/tofradyr
